title: Yara and the Ghost
author: Isandro Villalobos
blurb: Bram Quintana, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
